description: Rishta Lentil Noodles Lebanese is a heartwarming and traditional Middle Eastern dish, celebrated for its comforting blend of tender lentils and flat pasta noodles. This wholesome, vegetarian meal is infused with aromatic spices, tangy lemon, and often garnished with crispy fried onions, offering a delightful texture and rich flavor. It embodies the essence of Lebanese home cooking, perfect for a nourishing and satisfying experience.

ingredients.item: Flat egg noodles or homemade pasta

ingredients.notes: one finely diced, one thinly sliced for frying

instructions.title: Prepare the Lentils
instructions.text: Rinse the lentils thoroughly under cold water. In a large pot, combine the rinsed lentils with 4 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender but still hold their shape. Drain any excess water if necessary, but usually, it will be absorbed.

instructions.title: Fry Onions for Garnish
instructions.text: While lentils are cooking, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a separate pan over medium heat. Add the thinly sliced onion and fry, stirring occasionally, until deeply golden brown and crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain. Set aside for garnish.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.text: In the same large pot used for lentils (or a clean one), add 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Add the finely diced onion and sauté over medium heat until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and sauté for another 1 minute until fragrant.

instructions.title: Build the Base
instructions.text: Stir in the ground cumin, salt, and black pepper with the sautéed onions and garlic. Cook for 1 minute more, allowing the spices to become fragrant. Add the cooked lentils to the pot and stir to combine well with the aromatics and spices.

instructions.title: Cook the Noodles
instructions.text: Pour in the remaining 2 cups of water or vegetable broth. Bring the mixture to a gentle boil. Add the broken pasta noodles, stirring to prevent them from sticking. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, uncovered, for 8-10 minutes, or until the noodles are al dente and the liquid has thickened to a stew-like consistency. Stir occasionally.

instructions.title: Finish and Serve
instructions.text: Remove the pot from heat. Stir in the fresh lemon juice and half of the chopped fresh cilantro. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Ladle the Rishta Lentil Noodles into bowls. Garnish generously with the crispy fried onions and the remaining fresh cilantro. Serve hot.

tips: For truly authentic Rishta, consider making fresh flat pasta noodles at home. It adds an incomparable texture and flavor.
Adjust the amount of lemon juice to your preference; some like it tangier. A splash of pomegranate molasses can also add a unique depth.
This dish reheats beautifully. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. You might need to add a splash of water or broth when reheating to adjust consistency.
